$comment: Generator naming contract for the tina4 CLI, guarded by the generator-parity
The CLI forwards `generate`/`routes` verbatim to each framework CLI, so this
fixture pins the developer-VISIBLE, cross-language-identical output — route
paths, table names, migration names — plus the per-language file paths, and
asserts them end-to-end from a real `tina4 init` + `generate` + `routes` run.
Everything a developer SEES must be identical across the four frameworks
(Tina4 core principle 6); only file casing/extension is language-idiomatic.
Pluralisation rule (the ONE rule, applied consistently):
singular_base = snake_case(ClassName)               e.g. Order -> order, Product -> product
table/migration = singular_base, UNLESS it is a SQL reserved word, then plural
route path / route file / page+list template = pluralise(singular_base)
So the route is ALWAYS the single plural of the singular base -- never the
plural of an already-pluralised table. `route = table + 's'` is the bug: when
the table was pluralised for a reserved word it double-pluralises (orderss).

known_framework_bug.why: framework generators build route/template names as table + 's'; a reserved-word table is already plural (orders), so routes/templates double-pluralise to orderss. Lives in the framework generator (e.g. tina4-python/tina4_python/cli/__init__.py:1973 route_name = table + 's'), NOT the CLI, which forwards generate verbatim. Fix: route_plural = pluralise(snake(name)). Needs a framework PR across all four; the CLI cannot fix it.

tina4js.$comment: bug 3: generate must delegate to tina4js, not vite.
